ns2:course.label: Future Politics
ns2:course.description: Examines visions of the future drawn from science fiction literature as a way to engage with political and social theory and to cultivate the political imagination. Prerequisite: Six hours of political science credit or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Six hours of political science credit or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
